mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy accommodates growth.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS < 0.1% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market overheating condition (UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS > 148,000 thousand) triggers inflation fears and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns in UNRATE < 3.5 and PAYEMS > 148000 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A positive interaction between RSAFS above 600,000 million and HOUST above 1,500 thousand indicates robust consumer and housing demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns in RSAFS > 600000 and HOUST > 1500 periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A supply contraction regime (INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 < 2.0% annualized) indicates manufacturing weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 < 2.0 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained consumer spending growth (RSAFS > 630,000 million) signals strong demand, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns in RSAFS > 630000 periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid FEDFUNDS increase above 4.5% within 3 months signals aggressive tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns in FEDFUNDS > 4.5 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between UNRATE < 3.8% and PAYEMS > 150,000 thousand indicates extreme labor market tightness, triggering inflation-driven equity sell-offs over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in UNRATE < 3.8 and PAYEMS > 150000 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary easing regime (FEDFUNDS < 0.1% and CPIAUCSL < 3.0% annualized) supports equity expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in FEDFUNDS < 0.1 and CPIAUCSL < 3.0 periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year window.
